say:0:1623229001:0.text: In a small clearing, a bird nestles beside Sweep's flickering glow, warming her damp feathers with little pleased chirps. Sweep keeps the flame stable with careful focus. The moment feels safe and tender.

say:8:1623229008:0.text: She fell into some water and got spooked. I happened to be here... I'm able to offer a little warmth.
say:8:1623229008:0.source_cn: 她只是不小心掉进了水洼，又冷又怕。我刚好在这里……能提...

say:10:1623229009:0.text: Without any warning at all, a strong wind tears through the clearing. Sweep's flame wobbles wildly, and several blistering drops of wax land on dry pine needles and fallen leaves nearby.
say:10:1623229009:0.source_cn: 然而，恰在此时，一阵林间的强风毫无征兆地刮过！斯威普的...

say:12:1623229010:0.text: Szzzt! With a nasty hiss, orange flames shoot up instantly!
say:12:1623229010:0.source_cn: “嗞——！”刺耳的声响中，橘红色的火苗猛地窜了起来！

say:17:1623229012:0.text: Panic hits. Sweep tries to stomp out the flames with his metal footpads, only to slosh more wax into the fire with every awkward step.
say:17:1623229012:0.source_cn: 场面瞬间大乱！斯威普下意识地想用金属脚掌踩灭火苗，可笨...

say:19:1623229014:0.text: The calm from moments ago is completely shattered. Birds take flight, and startled cries from the animals echo from every direction.
say:19:1623229014:0.source_cn: 刚才的宁静被彻底打破，小鸟惊飞，动物们的惊呼声从四面八...

say:0:1623230001:0.text: Uh-oh. Gotta put that fire out now!

say:0:1623230001:0.female: Uh-oh. Gotta put that fire out now!

say:2:1623232001:0.text: B-But... that was my best hay... saved all autumn... for winter... Now it's all gone.
say:2:1623232001:0.source_cn: 这……可是我攒了整个秋天的上等干草……准备过冬的……现...

say:3:1623232002:1.text: You're worried about hay? We could've been burned alive if we'd spotted it any later!
say:3:1623232002:1.source_cn: 这是草料被烧的问题吗？刚才的火势多危险！要不是发现得早...

say:5:1623232003:0.text: The words strike a nerve. The animals erupt at once, voices piling over one another.
say:5:1623232003:0.source_cn: 这番话引起了动物们的共鸣，大家七嘴八舌地附和起来。

say:7:1623232004:0.text: Exactly! The forest used to be peaceful—then you two showed up. And quit sweeping the leaves like they're dirt! They feed the soil, protect roots, and make the forest look like itself!
say:7:1623232004:0.source_cn: 说得对！你们来了之后森林就没安宁过！你为什么非要清扫落...

say:8:1623232005:0.text: And that endless swish-swish-swish! It follows you everywhere. Got my fur standing up all day long. That noise doesn't belong out here.
say:8:1623232005:0.source_cn: 还有那没完没了的沙沙声！走到哪儿响到哪儿，吵得我神经紧...

say:9:1623232006:0.text: A-And he cleared the grass covering my burrow, leaving my babies totally exposed without shelter...
say:9:1623232006:0.source_cn: 他……他还把我窝边用来伪装的草都清理掉了，差点让我的孩...

say:14:1623232008:2.text: Hold it. Here's the real problem! You're seriously letting a walking flame wander around the woods?! Today it's hay... Next time what, the whole forest?
say:14:1623232008:2.source_cn: 等等！最根本的问题是，你们真的打算让一个小火苗在森林里...

say:19:1623232010:0.text: Candel's tip droops. Sweep's light dims to a small, shaken glow. Both of them look crushed.

say:22:1623232011:0.text: Well... they don't live or die by the forest the way we do, so they don't understand our rules... or our fears...
say:22:1623232011:0.source_cn: 唉……说到底，他们不依靠森林就能活下来，因此低估了我们...

choice_prompt:23:1623232011.text: Well... they don't live or die by the forest the way we do, so they don't understand our rules... or our fears...
choice_prompt:23:1623232011.source_cn: 唉……说到底，他们不依靠森林就能活下来，因此低估了我们的难处，也不在意森林的忌讳……

say:24:1623232012:0.text: You're a good friend of the woods, Magister. But... you can't watch them every second.
say:24:1623232012:0.source_cn: 不是我们不相信你，魔法师大人。只是……你总不能时时刻刻...

say:24:1623232012:0.female: You're a good friend of the woods, Magister. But... you can't watch them every second.

say:25:1623232013:0.source_cn: 不过……刚才要不是魔法师大人及时出手……后果真不敢想……

say:28:1623232015:1.female: These two... I don't think they belong here!

choice_prompt:7:1623234004.source_cn: 可我还是搞砸了……又一次。

say:9:1623234006:1.text: Maybe... doing nothing would be better for everyone.
say:9:1623234006:1.source_cn: 也许……我们什么都不做，反而对大家都好。
say:9:1623234006:1.male: Maybe... doing nothing would be better for everyone.
say:9:1623234006:1.female: Maybe... doing nothing would be better for everyone.

say:11:1623234007:1.text: For once, Candel has nothing to say. He simply leans against Sweep—two little troublemakers sinking into the same quiet gloom.
say:11:1623234007:1.source_cn: 坎德尔罕见地沉默了，只是默默靠在斯威普身边。两个小家伙...

say:12:1623234008:1.text: Some lessons can't be talked away. They'll have to swallow this one themselves.
say:12:1623234008:1.source_cn: 这种挫败感，终究需要他们自己消化。

say:13:1623234009:1.text: The dust settles for now. Time to tell Hepler what happened. Hopefully Candel and Sweep have learned a lesson.
say:13:1623234009:1.source_cn: 眼下风波暂平，你也该回去向赫普汇报情况了。希望这次教训...
say:13:1623234009:1.male: The dust settles for now. Time to tell Hepler what happened. Hopefully Candel and Sweep have learned a lesson.
say:13:1623234009:1.female: The dust settles for now. Time to tell Hepler what happened. Hopefully Candel and Sweep have learned a lesson.

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 提供帮助也要斟酌方法

say:0:1623235001:0.text: Letting them sit with it might do some good. I'll find Hepler.
say:0:1623235001:0.source_cn: 让他们思考一下也不是坏事，先回去找赫普吧。
say:0:1623235001:0.male: Letting them sit with it might do some good. I'll find Hepler.
say:0:1623235001:0.female: Letting them sit with it might do some good. I'll find Hepler.

say:1:1623236001:1.text: So, how are those two magical creations doing? Let me guess. It hasn't been... quiet.
say:1:1623236001:1.source_cn: 那两个魔法造物的情况怎么样？我猜，应该没少出乱子吧？
say:1:1623236001:1.male: So, how are those two magical creations doing? Let me guess. It hasn't been... quiet.
say:1:1623236001:1.female: So, how are those two magical creations doing? Let me guess. It hasn't been... quiet.

say:3:1623236002:1.text: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.
say:3:1623236002:1.source_cn: 森林离莱希拉姆这么近，魔法造物居然会主动尝试融入动物群...
say:3:1623236002:1.male: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.
say:3:1623236002:1.female: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.

say:4:1623236003:1.text: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.
say:4:1623236003:1.source_cn: 不管结果如何，只要它们愿意开始接触、开始磨合，对双方来...
say:4:1623236003:1.male: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.
say:4:1623236003:1.female: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.

say:5:1623236004:1.text: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.
say:5:1623236004:1.source_cn: 这件事前所未有，就连我也不清楚事情的走向会是怎样的。
say:5:1623236004:1.male: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.
say:5:1623236004:1.female: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.

say:6:1623236005:1.text: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1623236005:1.male: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1623236005:1.female: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:7:1623236006:1.text: But don't force it. They need to figure it out themselves, and the process is what makes it count.
say:7:1623236006:1.source_cn: 不过不用太刻意去干预。这条路需要他们自己走通才有意义。
say:7:1623236006:1.male: But don't force it. They need to figure it out themselves, and the process is what makes it count.
